title: Declare AuralExciter header with SVF and oversampler
description:
Create Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h only for Module B (Aural Exciter).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ for existing DSP header patterns (prepare/process, parameter smoothing, juce::dsp types)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (or equivalent) for how DSP modules are owned and prepared
- Any existing parameter IDs / ranges for EXC_TUNE, drive/mode, EXC_HARMONICS, EXC_AIR_GAIN, oversampling factor

Header requirements (declarations only; no heavy implementation):
- Class AuralExciter (or project-consistent name) with real-time-safe API: prepare(const juce::dsp::ProcessSpec&), reset(), process(juce::AudioBuffer<float>& or ProcessContextReplacing)
- juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter<float> (or StateVariableFilter) member for 2nd-order high-pass sidechain; cutoff driven by EXC_TUNE in [800 Hz, 10 kHz]
- juce::dsp::Oversampling<float> member for selectable 2x/4x polyphase FIR wrapping the non-linear stage; construct/configure and query latency only in prepare path (never allocate in process)
- Wave-shaper mode enum/selector for: Cubic Soft Clipping, Asymmetric Tube, Tape
- Post-saturation high-shelf Air EQ above 10 kHz driven by EXC_AIR_GAIN
- Smoothed parameters for drive gain G, delta bias (~0.15), and gamma (from EXC_HARMONICS) — no per-sample raw APVTS reads in process
- Pre-allocated buffers/state members only; no heap allocation, locks, or blocking in the audio path
- Includes limited to what the header needs; keep it self-contained for c.2 implementation

Do not write AuralExciter.cpp or any verification docs.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h declares AuralExciter with prepare/reset/process signatures
Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h declares SVF high-pass sidechain and Oversampling members
Source/DSP/AuralExciter.h declares wave-shaper mode and Air EQ high-shelf members/APIs
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate or construct Oversampling in process()
introduce locks or heap allocation on the audio path

allowed: declare DSP member types and public prepare/process API matching existing project DSP headers
use juce::dsp::StateVariableTPTFilter or project-equivalent SVF typedef
enum or int mode for three wave-shapers
forbidden: implement process body in the header beyond trivial inline getters
wire module into PluginProcessor or Editor
change plugin formats or CMake targets
